title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan (Short-term (PE)), FY2027 2nd recruitment
institution: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
about: JSPS Short-term (PE) postdoctoral fellowships let researchers from the US, Canada and Europe carry out research in Japan with a host. For the FY2027 2nd recruitment, hosts submit to JSPS by 8 January 2027; about 20 awards, results mid-May 2027.
requirements: For researchers from the US, Canada and Europe
Holders of professional degrees such as a JD or MD are not eligible unless they also hold a PhD
Applications go through a Japanese host institution, whose internal deadline may be a month or more earlier than JSPS's
Arrival in Japan between August 1, 2027 and March 31, 2028

upskill.name: Full course catalog
why: The stated requirements ("For researchers from the US, Canada and Europe", "Applications go through a Japanese host institution", "Arrival in Japan between August 1, 2027 and March 31, 2028") are eligibility criteria, not skills; no course objective covers them, and shortlist scores came from keyword overlap only (e.g. "professional", "recruitment").
Field is "Any field", so no single Academy page fits; the catalog link lets readers choose by discipline.
